prs.title: Ensure that img dimensions are derived synchronously
prs.author: TimvdLippe
prs.body:
Browsers apply the width and height attributes of a matching source element in a picture element to the img element as soon as the DOM changes, so the computed style reflects them right away. The spec only updated the img element's dimension attribute source when selecting an image source, which happens in a microtask.

Update the image data now updates the source set synchronously, before any early return. Update the source set now resets the dimension attribute source to the img element before looking at source elements, so removing the source element or moving the img element out of the picture element reverts it. When obtaining images on demand, relevant mutations also update the source set.

Selecting the image URL stays in the microtask, since moving it could fire the error event too soon.

Fixes #8207.

- [x] [Tests](https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt) are written and can be reviewed and commented upon at:
